note.limitBannerUrgent_one: Only 1 character left — more text may be cut.
note.limitBannerUrgent_other: Only {{count}} characters left — more text may be cut.
note.limitBannerFull: Limit reached for this {{noun}}. Shorten some text to continue.
note.previewPlaceholderNote: Tap the mic to dictate a note
note.previewPlaceholderJournal: Tap the mic to dictate today's journal
note.editNoteHint: Opens the keyboard to type or correct text
note.dictationHintTruncatedNote: Note is at the character limit — some dictation was cut.
note.dictationHintTruncatedJournal: Journal is at the character limit — some dictation was cut.
note.dictateHint: Long press to open and edit without dictating

dictation.webOnly: Dictation works in the phone app, not in the browser.
dictation.moduleMissing: Dictation needs a newer app install. Update Life Dashboard from the latest development APK.
dictation.notAvailable: Speech recognition is not available. Install "Speech Recognition & synthesis" from Google Play, then enable it under Settings → System → Languages → Voice input.
dictation.installTts: Install "Speech Recognition & synthesis" from Google Play, download your language under Offline speech recognition, then try again.
dictation.micLifeApp: Allow Microphone for Life Dashboard: Settings → Apps → Life Dashboard → Permissions → Microphone.
dictation.micBoth: Allow Microphone for Life Dashboard and for "Speech Recognition & synthesis" (Settings → Apps → each app → Permissions), then try again.
dictation.offlineModel: Download the offline voice model in the system dialog (or in Speech Recognition & synthesis settings), then try dictation again.
dictation.offlineCanceled: Offline voice model download was canceled. Open Speech Recognition & synthesis settings, download your language, then try again.
dictation.timedOut: Speech recognition took too long to start. Check Microphone permission for Life Dashboard and Speech Recognition & synthesis, then try again.
dictation.unavailable: Could not start speech recognition. Check that "Speech Recognition & synthesis" is installed and has Microphone permission.
dictation.language: This language is not available for speech recognition. Download it in Speech Recognition & synthesis settings, then try again.
dictation.network: Speech recognition needs network or an offline voice pack. Download your language offline in Speech Recognition & synthesis settings, or allow Network for that app.
dictation.busy: Speech recognition is busy. Wait a moment, then try again.
dictation.generic: Could not transcribe. Check Microphone permission for Life Dashboard and Speech Recognition & synthesis, then try again.
dictation.iosOnDevice: On-device speech recognition is not available. Enable Dictation in iOS Settings → General → Keyboard.
